name: Azeroth Companion
title: Intelligent Startup Engine — View-Aware Loading & Processing
features: Introduced Intelligent Startup Engine: the existing site router now triggers view-specific initialization instead of doing every optional task on Home.
Deferred Blizzard Talent Forge index requests, Loot Hunter reference catalog downloads, and the extra Release Center and Player Guide release-manifest checks until those tools are opened.
Deferred hidden-view processing for Character Dominion, Unified Dashboard, Progress Command, Item Atlas, Player Field Lab and the War Room group, refreshing their data when revisited.
Preserved the existing studio interfaces, manual gameplay data, short-lived verified Battle.net handoff, player backups and Cloudflare Worker without adding any new account permissions.
Maintained four CSS/JS network resources, retained the v4.7 compiled stylesheets and versioned the two JavaScript bundles to v4.8 for safer cache updates.
Extended deterministic bundle integrity checks plus a browser startup audit that verifies deferred requests and correct studio initialization in desktop Chromium and mobile WebKit.
Documented what is actually deferred and what remains eagerly downloaded, so reduced startup work is not incorrectly advertised as complete lazy code loading.
